info.title: Rclone RC API
info.description:
OpenAPI specification for the rclone RC API. Each release describes exactly one rclone version, shown in `info.version`.

## Scope

This covers the `POST` RC commands with JSON bodies. It doesn't cover rclone's file serving, `/metrics` or the web GUI.

Rclone also accepts these params in the query string or a form-encoded body, and an `_async` param. This spec leaves those out on purpose, so that each field has one documented form and `required` can be enforced. The exception is `operations/uploadfile`, whose params can only go in the query string.

A request with `Content-Type: application/json` and an empty body returns a 400. Send `{}`, or leave the header out. JSON bodies always cause a browser preflight, which rclone answers when `--rc-allow-origin` is set.

## Authentication

Routes use HTTP basic auth, with credentials from `--rc-user` and `--rc-pass`, or from `--rc-htpasswd`. With `--rc-user-from-header`, rclone takes the user name from an HTTP header instead. A missing or wrong login gets a plain text 401.

A server with no credentials set up answers these routes with a JSON 403, unless it runs with `--rc-no-auth`. Routes with an empty `security` list never need authentication.

## Running calls in the background

Send `Prefer: respond-async` to run a call in the background. Rclone returns a 202 with a job ID right away, and `job/status` reports progress. Rclone's `_async` param has the same effect, but on its own it returns a 200 with the job ID rather than the route's normal body. That can't be described here, so routes don't list it. The exception is `job/batch` inputs, which have no headers and use `_async` instead.

## What depends on the server

- `cache/*` only exists after a cache remote is created.
- `pluginsctl/*` only works with the web GUI.
- `mount/*` and the option blocks depend on how rclone was built.
- `backend/command` results depend on the backend.

post.description: Returns all supplied parameters unchanged so you can verify RC connectivity.
Permanently removes trashed objects from the specified remote path.

fs.description: Remote name or path to clean up, for example `drive:`.

post.description: Copies one object from a source remote and path to a destination remote and path.

srcFs.description: Source remote name or path, such as `drive:` or `/` for the local filesystem.

srcRemote.description: Path to the source object within `srcFs`, for example `dir/file.txt`.

dstFs.description: Destination remote name or path, such as `drive2:` or `/` for local filesystem.

dstRemote.description: Target path within `dstFs` where the file should be written.

post.description: Downloads a public URL and stores it at the requested remote path.

fs.description: Remote name or path that will receive the downloaded file, e.g. `drive:`.

remote.description: Destination path within `fs` where the fetched object will be stored.

url.description: Source URL to fetch the object from.

autoFilename.description: Set to true to derive the destination filename from the URL.

post.description: Deletes matching files and directories for the provided remote, honouring filters and config overrides.

fs.description: Remote name or path whose contents should be removed.

post.description: Removes a specific object from the remote.

fs.description: Remote name or path that contains the file to delete.

remote.description: Exact path to the file within `fs` that should be deleted.

post.description: Returns backend features, hash support, metadata descriptions, and other info for the remote.

fs.description: Remote name or path to inspect, e.g. `drive:`.

200.description: Capabilities, supported hashes, and metadata for the specified remote.

post.description: Produces a hash sum listing for files under the given path using the requested hash algorithm.

fs.description: Remote name or path to hash, such as `drive:` or `/`.

hashType.description: Hash algorithm to use, e.g. `md5`, `sha1`, or another supported name.

download.description: Set to true to force reading the data instead of using remote checksums.

base64.description: Set to true to emit hash values in base64 rather than hexadecimal.

200.description: Hash algorithm used and the ordered hash lines emitted by `operations/hashsum`.

post.description: Returns the hash of a single file using the specified hash algorithm.

fs.description: Remote name or path containing the file to hash.

remote.description: Path to the specific file within `fs` to hash.

hashType.description: Hash algorithm to use, e.g. `md5`, `sha1`, or another supported name.

download.description: Set to true to force reading the data instead of using remote checksums.

base64.description: Set to true to emit the hash value in base64 rather than hexadecimal.

200.description: Hash algorithm used and the hash value for a single file from `operations/hashsumfile`.

hashType.description: The hash algorithm that was used.

hash.description: The hash value of the file.

post.description: Moves one object from a source remote and path to a destination remote and path.

srcFs.description: Source remote name or path containing the file to move.

srcRemote.description: Path to the source object within `srcFs`.

dstFs.description: Destination remote name or path where the file will be moved.

dstRemote.description: Destination path within `dstFs` for the moved object.

post.description: Creates a share URL for an object or removes an existing link when `unlink=true`.

fs.description: Remote name or path hosting the object for which to manage a public link.

remote.description: Path within `fs` to the object for which to create or remove a public link.

unlink.description: Set to true to remove an existing public link instead of creating one.

expire.description: Optional expiration time for the public link, formatted as supported by the backend.

200.description: Public sharing URL returned by `operations/publiclink`.

post.description: Deletes empty subdirectories beneath the specified path, optionally leaving the root.

fs.description: Remote name or path to scan for empty directories.

remote.description: Path within `fs` whose empty subdirectories should be removed.

leaveRoot.description: Set to true to preserve the top-level directory even if empty.

post.description: Updates the storage class or tier for every object in the specified remote path.

fs.description: Remote name or path whose storage class tier should be changed.

post.description: Updates the storage class or tier for a single object.

fs.description: Remote name or path that contains the object whose tier should change.

remote.description: Path within `fs` to the object whose storage class tier should be updated.

post.description: Reports total size, file count, and number of objects without size metadata.

fs.description: Remote name or path to measure aggregate size information for.

200.description: Aggregate object counts and total size from `operations/size`.

post.description: Reads the current bandwidth limit or applies a new schedule string, just like `rclone rc core/bwlimit`.

rate.description: Bandwidth limit to apply, for example `off`, `5M`, or a schedule string.

200.description: Effective bandwidth limits in bytes per second and human readable form.

post.description: Executes a standard rclone CLI command remotely and streams or returns its output. Don't combine the `STREAM` return types with `Prefer: respond-async`, because the 202 is sent before the command runs.

command.description: Name of the rclone command to execute, for example `ls` or `lsf`.

200.description: Outcome of a command run with `core/command`. With the default `returnType` this is JSON. The `STREAM` return types write the output to the body as plain text.

post.description: Returns a list of locally accessible paths including mount points, user directories, and removable volumes.

200.description: Locally accessible paths including mount points, user directories, and removable volumes.

disks.description: Accessible local paths such as disk mount points, user home folders, and removable volumes.

post.description: Returns disk usage statistics for the supplied local directory (defaults to the cache dir).

dir.description: Local directory path to report disk usage for. Defaults to the rclone cache directory when omitted.

200.description: Disk usage summary for the requested directory.

post.description: Triggers Go's garbage collector to release unused memory.
Lists stats groups currently tracked by rclone.

200.description: Names of stats groups.

groups.description: Names of the stats groups, or null when there are none.

post.description: Returns Go runtime memory statistics similar to `runtime.ReadMemStats`.

200.description: Memory statistics fields from the Go runtime.

post.description: Obscures a plain-text secret for inclusion in `rclone.conf`.

clear.description: Plain-text string to obscure for storage in the config file.

200.description: Obscured string result.

post.description: Returns the process ID of the running rclone instance.

200.description: Process ID payload.

post.description: Stops the rclone process, optionally supplying an exit code.

exitCode.description: Optional exit code to use when terminating the rclone process.

post.description: Deletes the counters associated with a specific stats group.
Clears counters, errors, and finished transfers for the provided stats group or all groups.

group.description: Stats group identifier whose counters should be reset. Leave unset to reset all groups.

post.description: Returns up to 100 recently completed transfers for the requested stats group.

group.description: Stats group identifier to filter the completed transfer list. Leave unset for all groups.

200.description: Completed transfer records including size, status, and timestamps.

group.description: Stats group identifier this transfer belonged to.

srcFs.description: Source remote or filesystem used for the transfer.

dstFs.description: Destination remote or filesystem used for the transfer.

what.description: What the transfer was doing, such as `transferring` or `checking`. Bisync adds values such as `listing file - Path1`, so this is free text.

started_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the transfer started.

completed_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the transfer completed.

post.description: Controls the fraction of goroutine blocking events reported in the blocking profile. Use a rate of 1 to include every event, or 0 or less to turn profiling off.

rate.description: Sampling interval in nanoseconds for blocking profile collection; use 1 to capture all events.

post.description: Sets the garbage collection target percentage and returns the previous value. A negative percentage effectively turns garbage collection off, unless the memory limit is reached.

gc-percent.description: Target percentage of newly allocated data to trigger garbage collection.

200.description: Previous garbage collection target percentage returned after update.

post.description: Controls the fraction of mutex contention events reported in the mutex profile, and returns the previous rate. Use 0 to turn profiling off, or a negative rate to only read the current value.

rate.description: Sampling fraction for mutex contention profiling; set to 0 to disable.

200.description: Previous mutex profiling sampling rate.

post.description: Sets a soft memory limit for the Go runtime, in bytes, and returns the previous limit.

mem-limit.description: Memory limit in bytes. Use a string for values above 2^53, such as the default of 9223372036854775807.

200.description: Previous soft memory limit before the change.

post.description: Clears the cache of remotes created from backends. Call this after changing a backend's parameters, so that the next call creates the remote again.
Returns the number of entries in the cache of remotes.

200.description: Number of entries currently cached by the file system cache.

post.description: Returns the current mount points, which can be passed to `mount/unmount`.

200.description: Active mount points with source remote and mount time.

post.description: Mounts a remote as a file system with FUSE. If `mountType` isn't set, rclone tries `mount`, then `cmount`, then `mount2`. Mount and VFS options can also be given as top-level keys. Rclone rejects any other key.

fs.description: Remote path to mount, such as `drive:` or `remote:subdir`.

mountPoint.description: Absolute local path where the remote should be mounted.

mountType.description: Optional mount implementation to use (`mount`, `cmount`, or `mount2`).

mountOpt.description: Mount options, using the option names from `options/info`.

vfsOpt.description: VFS options, using the option names from `options/info`.

200.description: Mount created successfully.

mountPoint.description: Actual local path where the remote was mounted. May differ from the requested path (e.g. when '*' is used on Windows).

post.description: Returns the possible mount types, which can be passed to `mount/mount` as `mountType`.

200.description: List of mount backends available on this platform.

post.description: Unmounts the mount at `mountPoint`.

mountPoint.description: Local mount point path to unmount.

post.description: Unmounts all active mounts, and returns an error if an unmount fails.
Same as `rc/noop`, but requires authentication to validate access control.
Always returns an error response incorporating the supplied parameters, useful for testing error handling.
Returns metadata about every available RC command, including whether authentication is required.

200.description: Metadata for every available RC command, including auth requirements.

NoAuth.description: True if the call works without authentication.

post.description: Invokes a backend-specific management command against an optional remote.

fs.description: Remote name or path the backend command should target.

arg.description: Arguments passed to the backend command.

opt.description: Options passed to the backend command.

200.description: Backend command output and any additional returned fields.

post.description: Drops cached directory entries, and optionally cached file data, for the cache backend.

remote.description: Remote path to expire from the cache, e.g. `remote:path/to/dir`.

withData.description: Set this to drop cached chunk data along with directory entries. Rclone only checks whether the key is present, so any value turns it on, including `false`.

200.description: Confirmation that the path was cleared.

post.description: Ensures specified file chunks are cached locally for a cache remote. Rclone also accepts `_config` and `_filter` objects here, but this schema leaves them out, because it can't allow objects for only those two keys.

chunks.description: Comma-separated chunk specifier list (e.g. `0:10,25:30`) describing file pieces to prefetch.

file.description: File to fetch chunks of. Add more with keys that start with `file`, such as `file2`.

200.description: What was fetched for each file.

Error.description: Error message, or an empty string.

post.description: Returns runtime statistics for the cache backend.

200.description: Statistics for the cache remote.

post.description: Creates a new remote in `rclone.conf`, mirroring `rclone config create`.

name.description: Name of the new remote configuration.

type.description: Backend type identifier, such as `drive`, `s3`, or `dropbox`.

post.description: Removes an existing remote from `rclone.conf`.

name.description: Name of the remote configuration to delete.

post.description: Returns the contents of the config file as a JSON object keyed by remote name.

200.description: Entire rclone configuration grouped by remote.

post.description: Returns the key/value settings for a single remote.

name.description: Name of the remote configuration to fetch.

200.description: Configuration key/value pairs for the requested remote. An empty object if there's no remote with that name.

post.description: Returns the names of all remotes defined in the config file.

200.description: Names of configured remotes.

post.description: Returns the status of the interactive OAuth authentication server, including the authorization URL when it is running.

200.description: Status of the interactive OAuth authentication server.

status.description: Whether the OAuth authentication server is currently running.

authUrl.description: Authorization URL to open in a browser. Present only when status is "running".

post.description: Stops the interactive OAuth authentication server if one is running. Returns an error if no OAuth flow is in progress.
Sets obscured password fields for a remote configuration.

name.description: Name of the remote whose secrets should be updated.

post.description: Returns the paths to the config file, cache directory, and temporary directory.

200.description: Paths to the config file, cache directory, and temporary directory.

post.description: Returns metadata describing each supported storage provider.

200.description: Available backend providers and their metadata.

post.description: Points rclone at a specific `rclone.conf` file.

path.description: Absolute path to the `rclone.conf` file that rclone should use.

post.description: Unlocks the configuration file using the provided password.

configPassword.description: Password used to unlock an encrypted config file.

post.description: Updates an existing remote with new parameter values.

name.description: Name of the remote configuration to update.

post.description: Returns the running rclone version, build metadata, and Go runtime details.

200.description: rclone version, build information, and runtime details.

os.description: Operating system rclone is running on (e.g. linux, darwin).

isGit.description: True when built directly from a git checkout.

isBeta.description: Indicates whether this build is a beta version.

goVersion.description: Go toolchain version used to build rclone.

osArch.description: CPU architecture in use (e.g. arm64 (ARMv8 compatible)).

linking.description: Linking mode for the binary (static or dynamic).

goTags.description: Space separated Go build tags, if any.

post.description: Returns active transfer statistics including bytes transferred, speed, and error counts.

group.description: Stats group identifier to return a snapshot for. Leave unset to include all groups.

short.description: When true, omit the `transferring` and `checking` arrays from the response.

200.description: Current transfer statistics including totals, rates, and recent activity.

transferring.description: Active transfers currently in progress grouped by stats group.

post.description: Run a batch of rclone rc commands concurrently. An input can set `_async` to run in the background, and its entry in `results` is then a job ID. Inputs have no headers, so they can't use `Prefer`.

concurrency.description: Do this many commands concurrently. Defaults to --transfers if not set.

inputs.description: List of inputs to the commands with an extra _path parameter.

_group.description: Stats group this input accumulates under.

_async.description: Run this item in the background. Its entry in `results` is then a job ID. Items have no headers, so `Prefer` is not an option here.

200.description: Results of the batch job execution.

results.description: One entry for each input, in order. Each is that command's result, its error, or a job ID if the input set `_async`.

post.description: Returns identifiers of active and recently completed asynchronous jobs. Since rclone 1.75.2 this call requires authentication, so a server with no credentials set up returns 403 unless it runs with `--rc-no-auth`.

200.description: Identifiers of active and recently completed async jobs.

jobids.description: Job IDs suitable for use with `job/status` and `job/stop`.

runningIds.description: Array of integer job ids that are running.

finishedIds.description: Array of integer job ids that are finished.

post.description: Returns timing, success state, output, and progress for a specific job. Since rclone 1.75.2 this call requires authentication, so a server with no credentials set up returns 403 unless it runs with `--rc-no-auth`.

200.description: Detailed status for a background job, including timing, success flag, and optional output.

finished.description: True once the job has completed.

error.description: Error message, or empty string on success.

success.description: True if the job completed successfully.

progress.description: Progress measurements supplied by the underlying command.

post.description: Attempts to cancel a running job by ID.
Cancels all active jobs associated with the provided stats group.

group.description: Stats group name whose active jobs should be stopped.

post.description: Lists objects and directories for a remote path, returning the same fields as `rclone lsjson`.

fs.description: Remote name or path to list, for example `drive:`.

remote.description: Directory path within `fs` to list; leave empty to target the root.

200.description: Directory listing entries from `operations/list`, mirroring the `lsjson` format.

list.description: Array of entries equivalent to the items returned by `rclone lsjson`.

Path.description: Path relative to the requested remote root.

IsDir.description: True if the entry represents a directory.

Hashes.description: Hash digests keyed by algorithm when requested.

IsBucket.description: True for bucket/root entries on bucket-based remotes.

Tier.description: Storage class or tier, if supplied by the backend.

Encrypted.description: Encrypted entry name when using crypt remotes.

EncryptedPath.description: Encrypted path when using crypt remotes.

post.description: Returns metadata for a single file or directory, mirroring `rclone lsjson` on one entry.

fs.description: Remote name or path that contains the item to inspect.

remote.description: Path to the file or directory within `fs` to describe.

200.description: Metadata for a single file or directory from `operations/stat`.

Path.description: Path relative to the remote root.

IsDir.description: True if the entry is a directory.

Hashes.description: Hash digests keyed by algorithm when requested.

IsBucket.description: True for bucket/root entries on bucket-based remotes.

Tier.description: Storage class or tier, if supplied by the backend.

Encrypted.description: Encrypted entry name when using crypt remotes.

EncryptedPath.description: Encrypted path when using crypt remotes.

post.description: Returns storage quota and usage details for the remote, equivalent to `rclone about`.

fs.description: Remote name or path to query for capacity information.

200.description: Quota and usage information from `operations/about`, including total, used, and free space.

post.description: Accepts multipart/form-data payloads and writes the uploaded files to the specified remote path. Its parameters go in the query string, because rclone doesn't read them from a multipart body. A JSON body returns 200 and uploads nothing. This route can't run in the background.

requestBody.description: Multipart form payload containing one or more files to upload.

post.description: Deletes a directory or container and all of its contents. This can take a long time, so run it in the background with `Prefer: respond-async` to avoid HTTP timeouts.

fs.description: Remote name or path from which to remove all contents.

remote.description: Path within `fs` whose contents should be purged.

post.description: Creates the target directory or container if it does not exist.

fs.description: Remote name or path in which to create a directory.

post.description: Deletes an empty directory or container.

fs.description: Remote name or path containing the directory to remove.

post.description: Compares source and destination trees, reporting matches, differences, and missing files.

srcFs.description: Source remote name or path to verify, e.g. `drive:`. Required unless `checkFileHash` is set.

dstFs.description: Destination remote name or path that should match the source.

download.description: Set to true to read file contents during comparison instead of relying on hashes.

checkFileHash.description: Hash name to expect in the supplied SUM file, such as `md5`.

checkFileFs.description: Remote containing the checksum SUM file when using `checkFileHash`.

checkFileRemote.description: Path within `checkFileFs` to the checksum SUM file.

oneWay.description: Set to true to only ensure that source files exist on the destination.

combined.description: Set to true to include a combined summary report in the response.

missingOnSrc.description: Set to true to report files missing from the source.

missingOnDst.description: Set to true to report files missing from the destination.

match.description: Set to true to include matching files in the report.

differ.description: Set to true to include differing files in the report.

error.description: Set to true to include entries that encountered errors.

200.description: Comparison summary from `operations/check`, including missing, matching, and differing files.

success.description: True when the check completes without differences or errors.

hashType.description: Hash algorithm used for comparisons when applicable.

combined.description: Combined summary lines when `combined=true` is requested.

missingOnSrc.description: Files present on the destination but missing from the source.

missingOnDst.description: Files present on the source but missing from the destination.

match.description: Files that matched on both sides.

differ.description: Files that differed between source and destination.

error.description: Entries that produced errors during the check.

post.description: Synchronises a source remote to a destination remote, making the destination match the source. This can take a long time, so run it in the background with `Prefer: respond-async` to avoid HTTP timeouts.

srcFs.description: Source remote path to sync from, e.g. `drive:src`.

dstFs.description: Destination remote path to sync to, e.g. `drive:dst`.

createEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to create empty source directories on the destination.

post.description: Copies objects from a source remote to a destination remote without deleting destination files. This can take a long time, so run it in the background with `Prefer: respond-async` to avoid HTTP timeouts.

srcFs.description: Source remote path to copy from.

dstFs.description: Destination remote path to copy to.

createEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to replicate empty source directories on the destination.

post.description: Moves objects from a source remote to a destination remote, optionally cleaning up empty directories. This can take a long time, so run it in the background with `Prefer: respond-async` to avoid HTTP timeouts.

srcFs.description: Source remote path whose contents will be moved.

dstFs.description: Destination remote path that will receive moved files.

createEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to create empty source directories on the destination.

deleteEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to delete empty directories from the source after the move completes.

post.description: Performs a bidirectional synchronisation between two paths, supporting safety checks and recovery options.

dryRun.description: Set to true to simulate the bisync run without making changes.

resync.description: Set to true to perform a one-time resync, rebuilding bisync history.

checkAccess.description: Set to true to abort if `RCLONE_TEST` files are missing on either side.

checkFilename.description: Override the access-check sentinel filename; defaults to `RCLONE_TEST`.

force.description: Set to true to bypass the `maxDelete` safety check.

createEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to mirror empty directories between the two paths.

removeEmptyDirs.description: Set to true to remove empty directories during cleanup.

filtersFile.description: Path to an rclone filters file applied to both paths.

ignoreListingChecksum.description: Set to true to ignore checksum differences when comparing listings.

resilient.description: Set to true to allow retrying after certain recoverable errors.

workdir.description: Directory path used to store bisync working files.

noCleanup.description: Set to true to keep bisync working files after completion.

200.description: Bisync completed with session details.

output.description: Captured output from the bisync operation.

session.description: Session name derived from the two filesystems.

workDir.description: Absolute path to the bisync working directory.

listing1.description: Path to the Path1 listing file.

listing2.description: Path to the Path2 listing file.

post.description: Returns the names of option blocks that can be queried or updated.

200.description: Names of option blocks that can be queried with `options/get` or `options/info`.

post.description: Returns the current global option values, optionally filtered by block.

blocks.description: Optional comma-separated list of option block names to return.

200.description: Current global option values keyed by block name.

post.description: Returns metadata for options, including help text and defaults, grouped by block.

blocks.description: Optional comma-separated list of option block names to describe.

200.description: Metadata describing available options, organised by block.

post.description: Sets temporary option overrides for the running process by supplying key/value pairs grouped under option block names. Provide one or more query parameters whose names match the blocks you want to modify (for example `main`, `rc`, `http`). Each block parameter carries an object of option overrides.
Returns the current effective options for this request, including `_config` and `_filter` overrides.

200.description: Effective option values for the current request, separated into config and filter sections.

post.description: Returns all running `rclone serve` instances with their IDs and options.

200.description: List of active `serve` instances, including their IDs, bind addresses, and parameters.

addr.description: Address and port the server is listening on.

params.description: Serve configuration parameters supplied at startup.

post.description: Launches a new `rclone serve` endpoint (http, webdav, ftp, etc.) with the provided parameters. It also takes the options of the chosen server type, using the option names from `options/info`. Rclone rejects any other key.

fs.description: Remote path that will be served.

addr.description: Address and port to bind the server to, such as `:5572` or `localhost:8080`.

200.description: Confirmation of a newly started server, including ID and bound address.

addr.description: Address and port the server is listening on.

post.description: Stops a running `serve` instance identified by its ID.

id.description: Identifier of the running serve instance returned by `serve/start`.

post.description: Stops every active `serve` instance.
Returns the list of supported `rclone serve` protocols.

200.description: Supported rclone serve protocols.

post.description: Evicts specific files or directories from the VFS directory cache. All values must be strings. Rclone also accepts `_config` and `_filter` objects here, but this schema leaves them out, because it can't allow objects for only those two keys.

fs.description: Optional VFS identifier to target; required when more than one VFS is active.

file.description: File to forget. Add more with keys that start with `file`, such as `file2`.

dir.description: Directory to forget. Add more with keys that start with `dir`, such as `dir2`.

200.description: Paths evicted from the VFS directory cache.

post.description: Lists the active VFS instances and their identifiers.

200.description: Identifiers for the VFS instances currently in use.

vfses.description: VFS name that can be used with other VFS endpoints.

post.description: Reads or updates the VFS poll interval duration, optionally waiting for the change to apply.

fs.description: Optional VFS identifier whose poll interval should be queried or modified.

interval.description: Duration string (e.g. `5m`) to set as the new poll interval.

timeout.description: Duration to wait for the poll interval change to take effect; `0` waits indefinitely.

200.description: Status of the poll-interval setting, possibly including the new interval.

supported.description: True if the remote supports polling.

timeout.description: True if setting the interval timed out. Only present when setting it.

post.description: Returns the contents of the VFS upload queue.

fs.description: Optional VFS identifier whose upload queue should be inspected.

200.description: Upload queue entries for the selected VFS.

queue.description: Files waiting to upload. Absent when the VFS has no cache.

expiry.description: Seconds until the file is eligible for transfer.

delay.description: Delay between upload attempts in seconds.

uploading.description: True if the file is uploading now.

post.description: Sets the expiry time of a queued VFS upload item, optionally relative to its current value.

fs.description: Optional VFS identifier for the queued item.

id.description: Queue item ID as returned by `vfs/queue`.

expiry.description: New eligibility time in seconds (may be negative for immediate upload).

relative.description: Set to true to treat `expiry` as relative to the current value.

post.description: Refreshes one or more directories in the VFS cache, optionally recursively. All values must be strings. Rclone also accepts `_config` and `_filter` objects here, but this schema leaves them out, because it can't allow objects for only those two keys.

fs.description: Optional VFS identifier whose directory cache should be refreshed.

recursive.description: Must be the string `true` or `false`, not a JSON boolean.

dir.description: Directory to refresh. Add more with keys that start with `dir`, such as `dir2`.

200.description: Acknowledgement of directories refreshed in the VFS cache.

result.description: Map of refreshed directories to status messages.

post.description: Returns VFS statistics including disk cache usage and metadata cache counters.

fs.description: Optional VFS identifier whose statistics should be returned.

200.description: Runtime statistics for a VFS, including disk cache and metadata cache state.

fs.description: Name of the VFS.

inUse.description: Number of active references to the VFS.

diskCache.description: Disk cache metrics when caching is enabled.

hashType.description: Internal number of the hash the cache uses.

outOfSpace.description: True if the cache has run out of space.

opt.description: Effective options of the VFS. Durations are in nanoseconds, and sizes are in bytes.

post.description: Downloads and installs a plugin into the WebUI from the provided repository URL.

url.description: Repository URL of the plugin to install.

post.description: Returns plugins matching the requested MIME type and optional plugin type.

type.description: MIME type to match when listing plugins.

200.description: Loaded plugin metadata for the requested MIME type.

loadedPlugins.description: Installed plugins keyed by repository name.

loadedTestPlugins.description: Installed test plugins keyed by repository name.

post.description: Returns metadata for installed production and test plugins.

200.description: Lists installed production and test plugins with their metadata.

loadedTestPlugins.description: Metadata entries for installed test plugins.

post.description: Returns metadata for installed test plugins.

200.description: Metadata for installed test plugins keyed by repository name.

loadedTestPlugins.description: Installed test plugin metadata keyed by repository.

post.description: Uninstalls a plugin from the WebUI.

name.description: Name of the plugin to uninstall.

post.description: Uninstalls a test plugin from the WebUI.

name.description: Name of the test plugin to uninstall.

post.description: Removes keys from a remote in the config file.

200.description: The keys that were removed.

removed.description: The keys that were removed, or null if none were.

PreferAsyncHeader.name: Prefer
PreferAsyncHeader.description: Set to `respond-async` to run the call in the background. Rclone returns a 202 with a job ID right away, and `job/status` reports progress. This has the same effect as the `_async` param in rclone's docs, but `_async` alone returns a 200 instead of a 202.

GlobalGroupParam.name: _group
GlobalGroupParam.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

Operations_UploadfilePostFsParam.name: fs
Operations_UploadfilePostFsParam.description: Remote name or path where the uploaded file should be stored.

Operations_UploadfilePostRemoteParam.name: remote
Operations_UploadfilePostRemoteParam.description: Directory within `fs` to upload into. Use an empty string for the top of `fs`. Each file takes its name from its form part, and rclone skips parts with no file name.

UploadfileConfigParam.name: _config
UploadfileConfigParam.description: JSON encoded config overrides for this call only.

UploadfileFilterParam.name: _filter
UploadfileFilterParam.description: JSON encoded filter overrides for this call only.

EmptyObjectResponse.description: Request succeeded returning an empty JSON object.

AsyncJobResponse.description: The call is running in the background, because the request sent `Prefer: respond-async`. Poll `job/status` with the job ID. A job can be queried for up to 1 minute after it finishes.

jobid.description: Job identifier. Pass to /job/status to track progress.

RcNoopResponse.description: Echoes any supplied parameters, useful for testing RC connectivity.

ConfigStepResponse.description: An empty object, unless `opt.nonInteractive` is set. Then it describes the next step of the configuration.

State.description: State to send back to continue.

Option.description: The next question, if there is one.

Error.description: Error to show to the user.

Result.description: Result to send back to continue.

UnauthorizedResponse.description: Missing or wrong credentials. The auth layer sends this as plain text, before rclone's JSON errors apply.

input.description: Original request parameters echoed for debugging.

ConfigProviderOptionAny.description: Value of the option, in whichever type the option uses. A tristate option is an object.

CoreStatsTransfer.description: Progress metrics for an in-flight transfer.

bytes.description: Bytes transferred so far for this object.

group.description: Stats group name associated with this transfer.

name.description: Remote path of the object being transferred.

size.description: Total size in bytes of the object.

speed.description: Current transfer speed in bytes per second.

speedAvg.description: Current speed in bytes per second as an exponentially weighted moving average.

srcFs.description: Source remote or filesystem for this transfer.

dstFs.description: Destination remote or filesystem for this transfer.

CoreStatsChecking.description: Metadata for an item currently undergoing verification.

group.description: Stats group name associated with this verification.

name.description: Remote path of the object being verified.

size.description: Total size in bytes of the object.

RemoteDefinition.description: A remote defined inline. Needs `type` or `_name`. Other keys are backend options and must be strings.

_config.description: Config overrides for this call only.

_filter.description: Filter overrides for this call only.

ConfigProviderOverview.description: Summary of the backend from rclone's docs. Its fields are empty for backends without one.

RcloneJobId.description: ID of the job that ran this call. Streamed responses may not include it.

PreferenceApplied.description: Confirms that the `Prefer` header was applied.
